title: A Portrait for the Harvest
author: Juniper Vane
blurb: Emrys Ravensworth, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must return what was taken in 1974 before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
